products.name: Sky Blue
facts: Available to companies within four years of formation.
Out-of-network ATM-fee rebates are documented up to $15.00 per month.
The first six months are free; the monthly maintenance fee is $25.00 after that period.

products.name: Lime Green
facts: Eligible out-of-network ATM fees are rebated up to $25.00 per month.
A dedicated account manager is available through secure message and priority phone support.
The $25.00 monthly maintenance fee is waived at a $15,000 balance.
A $5,000 end-of-day balance is the documented minimum for account benefits and avoiding balance-related charges.

promotion.rule: Apply this order only among candidates that meet every stated customer requirement.
